review_scope: Combinations of public-safe portfolio, proof-bank, lifecycle, social-census, archive, media, and resume information.

risks.risk: Re-identification or disclosure of protected participation.
risks.control: Do not commit participant or stakeholder lists; publish event-level public facts only.
risks.trigger: Any proposed person-level event or coalition record requires human privacy and consent review.

risks.risk: Shared-account activity can be misassigned to Jamie or inflated into endorsement and impact.
risks.control: Separate account establishment, known authorship, outbound mentions, inbound engagement, and unknown authorship.
risks.trigger: Any new social metric must define population, direction, account class, missingness, and anti-inferences.

risks.risk: Aggregate proof can expose or invite inference about private business performance.
risks.control: Keep contribution language aggregate and omit dashboards, time-series detail, customer data, and vendor terms.
risks.trigger: Any more precise financial claim requires business-owner approval of exact wording and surface.

risks.risk: Metadata can be mistaken for identity, consent, schedule, or publication rights.
risks.control: Treat identity, date, place, meaning, rights, and consent as separate reviews.
risks.trigger: Any display candidate requires rights and consent clearance independent of source custody.

risks.risk: A deliberately bounded contact detail can become broadly indexed or duplicated.
risks.control: Keep phone out of public HTML and retain PDF-specific noindex handling.
risks.trigger: Any resume asset or routing change reruns PDF, robots, sitemap, and header checks.

residual_risk: Public facts can still be combined externally. The repository therefore minimizes person-level records, keeps protected locators opaque, and requires exact-surface review for new projections.
